author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: न केवलं लाघवप्राप्तिः । तवाहिताः शत्रवः अवाच्यवादान्वचनानर्हशब्दान्बहून्वदिष्यन्ति । ततः शत्रुकृतनिन्दादिश्रवणात् दुःखतरं अतिशयितदुःखं किं नु ? न किमपीत्यर्थः ॥ २.३६॥
translation:
Thine enemies will utter many a reproach unworthy to be spoken, slandering thy prowess and ability; than which what could possibly be greater misery? (36) 
A. With regard to the uncertainty of success or defeat Which Arjuna las advanced as a plea, the Lord observes there is nothing to be lost in either case:
